sections.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with the Human subtype. Base land speed 30 ft. The printed entry gives no racial ability-score adjustment, natural armor, or level adjustment.
Darkvision reaches 60 ft. and sees in black and white. +2 racial bonus on Listen checks.
Gain 4 extra skill points at 1st level after the class calculation and 1 extra skill point each subsequent level.
Weapon Familiarity treats light and heavy picks as simple weapons.

Camouflage (Ex): change skin coloration at will to match terrain. Gain a +4 racial bonus to Hide, which increases to a total of +10 in rocky terrain. Darkvision does not negate the bonus. True seeing negates it. Normal Hide requirements still apply.
Light Sensitivity (Ex): bright sunlight or the radius of a daylight spell causes the dazzled condition. In 3.5, dazzled gives −1 to attack rolls, Search, and Spot.
Common is automatic. The printed bonus languages are Drow, Dwarven, Gnome, Goblin, and Orc. Favored class Any. For multiclass experience penalties, exclude the highest-level class.

sections.title: Original NPC · Berren Shalebank
lines: Motive. Identify which shipment carries a counterfeit stamp before the ore lots are mixed.
Hook. Berren can compare the samples in the covered counting room if the party finds the missing merchant seal.
Underfolk ore assayer, Expert 1 · Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 1. · Medium Humanoid (Human)

sections.title: Original NPC · Lysa Chalkmark
lines: Motive. Find a quiet gap in an old stone sentry’s route so repairers can reach a counterweight.
Hook. Lysa can listen for the sentry and guide the party between passes if they leave the narrow ledge clear.
Underfolk gallery watch, Ranger 1 · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1. · Medium Humanoid (Human)
